input.prompt: The camera is completely locked off like a tripod shot: no zoom, no push-in, no drift, no pan, no camera movement at all. The yellow print on her black T-shirt (the words '1966', 'ISLAY', 'WAS', 'FRUIT' and the seagull line drawing) stays exactly the same: same letters, same spelling, same shapes, never redrawn, never morphing, it only moves naturally with the fabric. The printed letters are a plain upright typewriter-style serif font and stay perfectly upright and sharp in every frame, never italic, never slanted, never wavy. Close-up of a woman's chest wearing a black T-shirt with a yellow print, like a still product photo that slowly comes alive. The T-shirt fabric and the print do not move at all. Her hand rests still on the hem and does not pull it. The only motion is a very slow, gentle breath and the warm bokeh lights of the whisky bar softly twinkling in the background, plus a strand of her hair moving slightly. Realistic cinematic product shot.
